invariant: A skinparam or creole font name is measured with the face JDK 21 returns for that name on macOS, for every family Rust already models (Lucida Grande, Arial, Helvetica, Verdana, Menlo, Courier New, Times New Roman), including English case-folding and the PostScript names the JDK registers.
causal_divergence: metric_family maps only Courier, monospace and Monospaced onto the Menlo cell. The family name Menlo, and every PostScript name of a modelled face, falls through to Lucida Grande. The round-9 face probe (Menlo plain, Menlo-Regular) measures Pier x at 14 pt as 50.572265625, which is 6 * 1233/2048 * 14. Rust measures the same string as Lucida Grande.
planned_change: Decode the name the way Font.decode does, then resolve a modelled family (requested bold/italic kept) or a registered PostScript name (findFont2D's PLAIN-keeps-the-face rule, otherwise OR the styles). Unmodelled names stay on the Dialog fallback, Lucida Grande. Do not retarget the physical name Times: the reference census has no Times family, and the goldens that say defaultFontName Times already match Dialog.

The relayed face probe shared-svg-round9-face-probe records Menlo plain getPSName Menlo-Regular and getStringBounds(Pier x) = 50.572265625 at 14 pt.
